$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

manifestVersion.description: Pack wrapper JSON shape version. Checked first; unknown versions fail fast.

packId.description: Stable pack slug within the author's namespace.

authorId.description: Structured slug identifying who maintains/distributes this pack.

name.description: Human-readable pack title shown in Studio lists and pack detail.

description.description: Short summary for lists/hero; use README.md for longer notes.

icon.description: Optional pack icon path relative to the pack root (e.g. icon.png). Prefer a square PNG at 128×128 or 256×256 (256 for sharp 2×).

minAppVersion.description: Optional semver floor for app capabilities.
